name: qa-portal-frontend
description: Centralized QA Portal -- single React + Vite SPA. Domain areas (Functional, Security, Specialised Testing, Governance) live as plain folders under src/modules/ and are code-split via React.lazy(), but all ship in one build/deploy -- this project previously used a Module Federation micro-frontend split (separate images per module) and was consolidated back into one app; see README 'Frontend architecture'.
